disclosure: PROPOSED STANDARD v0.1 (UNAPPROVED PREVIEW). Thresholds are bodyweight-adjusted candidate targets for review and self-reported progress tracking. Official MONTE Verified ranks remain locked until owner sign-off and reviewer activation.

ranks.name: Debitan
ranks.summary: The beginning. Establish a legitimate, technically sound lift.
ranks.tierNote: Earned, never automatic. Requires full movement standard.

ranks.name: Bati
ranks.summary: Build a consistent foundation of strength.
ranks.tierNote: Foundational barbell strength under strict control.

ranks.name: Solid
ranks.tierNote: Established gym strength with zero form compromise.

ranks.name: Fò
ranks.summary: Show substantial strength beyond the foundation.
ranks.tierNote: Strong intermediate standard across bodyweight classes.

ranks.name: Avanse
ranks.summary: Reach an advanced level of strength.

ranks.name: Mèt
ranks.tierNote: Mastery of heavy load and strict technical execution.

ranks.name: Chanpyon
ranks.summary: Achieve a highly demanding strength standard.
ranks.tierNote: Candidate verification floor: video review required once active.

ranks.name: Titan
ranks.summary: Reach an elite level of performance.
ranks.tierNote: Rare national/international raw drug-tested strength territory.

ranks.name: Lejand
ranks.summary: The highest distinction; extremely difficult to earn.
ranks.tierNote: World-class raw standard. Reserved for extraordinary lifts.

evidence.dataset: Proposed candidate curve anchored to raw drug-tested powerlifting class benchmarks (IPF weight-class spine 47-120+ kg) and strict straight-bar curl ratios; awaiting formal cohort calibration.
evidence.license: Internal MONTE WO v0.1 engineering proposal — not published as official.
evidence.holdoutReport: Pending athlete-split holdout study before production sign-off.
evidence.biasReport: Damped allometric scaling (b=0.60..0.67) prevents linear bodyweight bias; subgroup fairness audit required.
evidence.rankMeaningReport: Debitan through Lejand monotonic 9-tier progression with widening elite intervals.
evidence.limitations: PROPOSED STANDARD v0.1 (UNAPPROVED PREVIEW). Does not award official or MONTE Verified ranks.
